# Vendored artifacts (out-of-the-box build, no Sail toolchain needed)

- `model.cpp.gz` + `model.h` + `model_missing.cpp` — C++ generated by
  **Sail 0.20.1's `--cpp` backend** from
  [rems-project/sail-arm](https://github.com/rems-project/sail-arm)
  `arm-v9.4-a` (master, 2026-06) plus this crate's `sail/harness.sail`,
  using the command in README Step 2 **followed by
  `scripts/fix_cpp_model.py`** (the cpp backend needs four mechanical fixes
  on this model — see the script's docstring). The model is a C++ class
  (`model::Model`): all architectural state is per-instance, enabling
  multiple independent oracles per process. License: BSD-3-Clause-Clear
  (Arm Limited et al.; see the sail-arm repository LICENSE).
- `sail-runtime/` — the Sail C runtime (`sail.c`, `rts.c`, `sail_failure.c`,
  `sail_config.c`, `cJSON.c` + headers) copied from the `sail` 0.20.1 opam
  package (`$(opam var share)/sail/lib`), **with patches** (all marked
  `PORTABILITY PATCH` / `REENTRANCY PATCH` / `CPP-BACKEND PATCH`):
  - arbitrary precision goes through the bundled **mini-gmp/mini-mpq** instead
    of system GMP (define `SAIL_SYSTEM_GMP` to switch back);
  - `gmp_*printf`/`gmp_sscanf`/`asprintf` replaced with portable equivalents;
  - POSIX `clock_gettime` → C11 `timespec_get`; `getline` fallback for
    Windows; `getopt` stubbed under MSVC;
  - `elf.c` dropped entirely (nothing in the model references it), which also
    removes the zlib dependency;
  - `setup_rts`/`cleanup_rts` refcounted (multiple model instances share the
    process-wide runtime);
  - inline aliases `sint`/`sub_vec_int` for primitives the cpp backend calls
    under different names than the C backend;
  - **LLP64 fix** (`sail.h`): on Windows `unsigned long` is 32-bit, so GMP's
    `*_ui`/`*_si` entry points silently truncate the 64-bit values the
    runtime passes through them (a 64-bit `STR` lost its upper half). The
    eight affected entry points are macro-redirected to 64-bit-safe inline
    versions on such platforms; no effect on LP64 (Linux/macOS).
  License: BSD-2-Clause (Sail authors); cJSON is MIT.
- `sail-runtime/mini-gmp.{c,h}`, `mini-mpq.{c,h}` — from **GMP 6.3.0**
  (`gmp-6.3.0/mini-gmp/`). ⚠️ License: **dual LGPLv3+ / GPLv2+** — unlike the
  rest of the crate (BSD). Statically linking it is fine for internal use;
  for distribution, LGPL §4 obligations apply, or build with
  `SAIL_SYSTEM_GMP` + system libgmp (same license situation) — GMP simply is
  LGPL either way.

`build.rs` uses all of this automatically when `SAIL_MODEL_C`/`SAIL_LIB_DIR`
are not set; `model.cpp.gz` (166 MB → 18 MB) is decompressed into `OUT_DIR` at
build time. The default build is **fully self-contained**: no GMP, no zlib,
no opam/Sail/z3 — just C and C++ compilers (C++20: g++ 10+/clang 10+/VS2019
16.11+).

To regenerate after editing `sail/harness.sail`, follow README Step 2 (which
ends with `fix_cpp_model.py`), then refresh with:

```sh
gzip -9 -c /path/to/sail-arm/arm-v9.4-a/cpp/model.cpp > vendor/model.cpp.gz
cp /path/to/sail-arm/arm-v9.4-a/cpp/model.h \
   /path/to/sail-arm/arm-v9.4-a/cpp/model_missing.cpp vendor/
```

(The runtime here is independent of the generated model — only re-copy
`sail-runtime/` sources if you upgrade Sail itself, and then re-apply the
patch hunks.)
